speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent, and I need to assess this newborn's respiratory distress immediately. Can you tell me how old the baby is and exactly when the breathing difficulties started?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The infant is a preterm (32 weeks) born via C-section, with a lack of antenatal steroids (implied by C-section) and maternal gestational diabetes, which are major risk factors for surfactant deficiency and neonatal hypoglycemia-related respiratory issues. Immediate chest X-ray and blood glucose testing are indicated to confirm alveolar collapse and metabolic status.
